name: the empty password
ref: the well-known LM hash of the empty password (Microsoft KB 299656 and Wikipedia, LAN Manager); each half is DES(KGS!@#$%) under the zero key, checked with OpenSSL DES-ECB

name: password, lower case
ref: the well-known LM hash of password (uppercased to PASSWORD); both halves checked against OpenSSL DES-ECB

example.title: A lower-case password is folded to upper case
example.note: The text password is upper-cased before hashing, so the digest, which starts e52cac67, matches that of the upper-case input PASSWORD.

name: Password, mixed case is the same
ref: upper-casing before hashing: same as PASSWORD

name: PASSWORD, upper case
ref: the well-known LM hash of PASSWORD

example.title: The LM hash of PASSWORD
example.note: PASSWORD gives a digest starting e52cac67, the same value as the lower-case password: the LM hash does not see the case.
